def valid(number):
    """Return True if number passes the Luhn checksum."""
    if not isinstance(number, str):
        return False

    digits = number.replace(" ", "")
    if len(digits) < 2 or not digits.isdigit():
        return False

    total = 0
    double = len(digits) % 2
    for index, char in enumerate(digits):
        digit = ord(char) - ord("0")
        if index % 2 == double:
            digit *= 2
            if digit > 9:
                digit -= 9
        total += digit

    return total % 10 == 0
